Large Language Models (LLM)
Large Language Models are AI models that are the core subject of a professional training course, with various characteristics, capabilities, and selection strategies discussed.

Professional Training Course
A professional training course focused on Large Language Models (LLM) series products, tools, and prompt engineering, targeting professionals in the financial industry.

Financial Industry
The financial industry is the target sector for the training course, with roles including product managers, operations staff, technical developers, data analysts, and risk management personnel.

Prompt Engineering
Prompt engineering is a core topic of the training, involving the design, optimization, and application of efficient prompts for specific financial scenarios.<SEP>The practice of designing effective prompts (instructions) for Large Language Models.<SEP>A method involving designing, testing, and optimizing prompts for large language models, including techniques like Chain-of-Thought and Few-shot learning.

DeepSeek
DeepSeek is an international representative LLM noted for being open-source and having strong code capabilities.

ChatGPT
ChatGPT is an international representative LLM noted for its comprehensive capabilities and plugin ecosystem.

Claude
Claude is an international representative LLM noted for its long-text processing and focus on safety and ethics.

Gemini
Gemini is an international representative LLM noted for its multimodal capabilities and integration with the Google ecosystem.

文心一言(ERNIE Bot)
文心一言is a domestic Chinese representative LLM noted for its Chinese language understanding and integration with the Baidu ecosystem.

通义千问(Tongyi Qianwen)
通义千问is a domestic Chinese representative LLM noted for its comprehensive capabilities and integration with the Alibaba ecosystem.

讯飞星火(iFlytek Spark)
讯飞星火is a domestic Chinese representative LLM noted for its voice interaction and cross-domain knowledge.

Open Source LLM
Open Source LLMs are defined and contrasted with closed-source models, with considerations for cost, customization, data privacy, and community support.

Closed Source LLM
Closed Source LLMs are defined and contrasted with open-source models, with considerations for cost, customization, data privacy, and update frequency.

Multimodal Capabilities
Multimodal capabilities of LLMs include image understanding, image generation, and audio processing, demonstrated through tasks like interpreting financial report charts.

Tool Use
Tool Use, or Function Calling, is a mechanism for LLMs to call external APIs or generate code, such as for real-time stock price queries.

Safety and Compliance
Safety and compliance issues for LLMs include bias, data leakage risks, hallucination, and fact-checking, with particular importance in financial scenarios.

API Calling
API Calling is a method for using LLMs, involving RESTful APIs and parameters like model, temperature, and maximum token count.

Large Cloud Platform Services
Large Cloud Platform Services like AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI Service, and Google Vertex AI offer LLM as a Service with managed, scalable solutions.

On-Premises Deployment
On-Premises Deployment is an enterprise-level LLM deployment strategy contrasted with cloud services, focusing on data control, security, cost, and maintenance.

Cloud Service
Cloud Service is an enterprise-level LLM deployment strategy contrasted with on-premises deployment, focusing on data control, security, cost, and maintenance complexity.<SEP>An LLM deployment method where the model is accessed via a public cloud provider.

data.entity_name: LLM Application Development Platforms And Tools
data.content:
LLM Application Development Platforms And Tools
Platforms and frameworks used to build applications with LLM capabilities.

Low-Code/No-Code Platforms
Platforms like Zapier, Make, and Coze that enable building LLM applications with minimal coding.

Application Development Frameworks
Frameworks like LangChain and LlamaIndex for building complex LLM applications.

Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
A technique that combines a knowledge base with an LLM to reduce hallucinations and keep knowledge updated.

Prompt
The input instruction given to an LLM, crucial for obtaining desired outputs.

CRISP/RCIOS Framework
A structured framework for designing effective prompts.

Role
A prompt element that defines the persona the LLM should adopt.

Instruction
A prompt element that specifies the task for the LLM to perform.

Context
A prompt element that provides background information or input data for the LLM.

Output Format
A prompt element that specifies the desired structure of the LLM's response.

Task Decomposition
A prompt technique that breaks a complex task into smaller sub-tasks.

Chain Of Thought (CoT)
A prompting technique that guides the LLM through a step-by-step reasoning process.

Few-Shot Learning
A prompting technique that provides the LLM with a few examples of input-output pairs.<SEP>A prompting technique that provides the model with a few examples to guide its response.

Zero-Shot Learning
A prompting technique that relies on the LLM's general capabilities without providing examples.

Iterative Optimization
The process of testing, analyzing output, and modifying prompts to improve results.

Zapier
A low-code/no-code platform that integrates LLM capabilities.

Make
A low-code/no-code platform that integrates LLM capabilities.

Coze
A low-code/no-code platform that integrates LLM capabilities.

An application development framework for building complex LLM applications.

An application development framework for building complex LLM applications.

Knowledge Base
